data.desc: Callan JMB Inc. (NASDAQ: CJMB) is a diversified logistics, preparedness, and critical-infrastructure company supporting healthcare organizations, government agencies, and commercial partners. The Company provides fulfillment, warehousing, cold-chain logistics, monitoring, regulatory compliance, specialty packaging, and emergency-preparedness services designed to protect critical products, strengthen supply chains, and support continuity of operations. Through its businesses and strategic partnerships, Callan JMB is building a broader platform spanning healthcare and pharmaceutical logistics, domestic manufacturing, and critical electrical infrastructure.
